Marbella’s coastline — from Puerto Banús to Cabopino and Estepona — is best explored by water. Without a license, you can still enjoy a private boat charter because every vessel comes with a professional skipper. That means no stress about navigation, mooring, or safety. You just show up, relax, and take in the views of La Concha mountain, the Golden Mile, and the Mediterranean.

Our Tier A boats are the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús and include everything you need. Prices are fixed for 2036:

  • 4 hours: €1,199
  • 6 hours: €1,699
  • 8 hours: €2,299

Every charter in our fleet includes:

Booking is straightforward. For Tier A and B boats, you can reserve directly on our site. For other vessels, send a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, group size, and duration. We’ll respond within hours with a price and availability. All departures are from Puerto Banús, Marbella.
